name: Sanity's Eclipse
description: Hurls a psionic orb at a tile within %cast_range% tiles. After %delay% turn it detonates, dealing %int_diff_dmg% damage to every enemy within %radius% tile for each point of intelligence this unit has over them.
details: The area the blast will cover is marked on the board while the orb is in the air.
It reaches units held by Oblivion Confinement.
